The error comes from the word "input" in the comments. I've reworded them and made a few sizing changes for gain margin at the hot corners.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Comments contained the forbidden token 'input'; reworded. Lengthened Lp to 1.0 and added sizing margin for gain and phase margin at ss/125C. The topology stays a Miller two-stage with a nulling resistor."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # diff pair L (flicker noise, gain)
    "I1":    (17e-6, 8e-6, 40e-6),   # current per diff-pair device
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS load / second-stage L
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS load and M6 gm/Id
    "I7":    (200e-6, 100e-6, 350e-6),
    "Cc":    (1.5e-12, 0.6e-12, 3e-12),
    "kRz":   (1.6, 0.8, 4.0),        # Rz = kRz / gm6
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "gmidn": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # NMOS current-source gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1 = p["I1"]; Itail = 2 * I1; I7 = p["I7"]; Cc = p["Cc"]

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.8)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Itail, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    gm6 = m6.gm
    Rz = p["kRz"] / gm6

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "d2", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "d2", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + C1 * cl + cl * Cc))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    den = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / gm6)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * den) if den > 0 else 1e15
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    power = (iref + Itail + I7) * 1.8
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = math.sqrt(noise_th**2 + (120e-9)**2)
    swing = 1.8 - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.2
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8)
    cmrr = db(2 * a1 * m3.gm / max(m5.gds, 1e-12)) - 6
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise,
               "psrr_db": gain_db - 25, "cmrr_db": min(cmrr, gain_db)}
```
